body.name: Exactly-\(B\) chronological design class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak D_{n,B}=\{d=(m,q,w):m\text{ satisfies ass:deterministic-partition};\ q=(q_b)_{b=1}^B\text{ consists of maps }q_b:(\mathsf H_{b-1},\mathcal G_{b-1})\to(\mathbb Z,2^{\mathbb Z})\text{ satisfying ass:predictable-counts and ass:fixed-overlap-counts};\ w\text{ satisfies ass:deterministic-simplex-weights}\}\).
